Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency profile looked promising. We're lining up our final evaluation sprint and legal/procurement have a handful of security items that need to be settled before we can sign a short-term pilot (and then move to Dedicated capacity). Can you confirm the items below and let me know who on your side will own each?

High-level asks:
- Current SOC 2 report (in-scope for infrastructure + processing) and date of last audit.
- SIG/CAIQ answers for the hosted API and Private (VPC) deployment. A short CSV or spreadsheet is fine.
- Draft DPA with Redwood's standard data deletion SLA and any EU/US residency options.
- Clarify retention for telemetry logs vs. user content (we need separate retention buckets; what are defaults and how to change them).
- For the evaluation, does Redwood provide a Data Processing Addendum (DPA) that covers ephemeral evaluation data and a 30/60/90-day deletion option?

Attachments: none on our side yet — legal asked for items first.

We're hoping to close the pilot PO by the end of next week pending these items. If we can get a mutual action plan (MAP) with owners and dates, that would help speed approvals.

Best,
Sam

2) DPA draft + redline window — Legal (Redwood) / Everguard Legal — target: draft by 5/18, redlines returned by 5/20.

4) Test plan for evaluation (data flow, sample workloads, deletion verification) — Olga/Jonas — target: 5/22.
5) Pilot PO & procurement checklist — Kimberly (Redwood Sales Ops) — target: 5/25.

Short notes on your questions:
- SOC 2: last audit completed Oct 2025; scope: infra, serving runtime, logging pipeline (summary in attached PDF). Full report available under NDA — we can exec an NDA if Everguard needs it.
- SIG/CAIQ: attached spreadsheet maps hosted vs Private feature differences (KMS, network egress controls, audit log retention).
- DPA + deletion SLA: Redwood's standard DPA includes a 30-day deletion SLA for cached evaluation payloads and a separate provision for long-term archived logs (default 365d). We can offer a 90-day archived logs option for pilots under a temporary SOW; I will have Legal produce a DPA draft that flags these clauses.
- Telemetry vs user content: we separate telemetry (retention default 365d) and customer content (default 90d for hosted; customer-managed for Private).

If this MAP looks good, I'll circulate a DocuSign-ready DPA draft and a short Drive folder with test artifacts.

Onwards,
Olga Petrov

Thanks Sam / Olga — adding a couple technical clarifications from infra that will affect the MAP timing:

- KMS & key escrow: For Private we support customer-managed KMS (Cloud KMS/HSM). For Hosted, we offer envelope encryption and an optional KMS integration for enterprise plans; lead time for escrow paperwork ~2 weeks if required.
- Audit/log retention tiers: we maintain three tiers — 30d (short), 365d (default), and 7 years (archival, add-on). The 365d default is what Olga referenced; if Everguard needs a 90d default for hosted evaluation we can set that per-tenant for the pilot.
- Data deletion verification: infra can provide deletion receipts (sha256 markers) for sample datasets during the test plan, and we can run a one-time verification run after deletion is executed.

If procurement needs a sample clause for the DocuSign DPA that calls out deletion receipts, I can draft the recommended language and push to Legal.

-Jonas
Jonas Weber

Redwood Inference
